intro_md: 🎧 **8 min.** Now **hear** what you just read – ears first, words after. Same words → your ears learn the sound of words you already know.

parts.title: Lunch with Tom – audio
parts.md:
**Train your ears – the words are hidden at first:**
1. 👂 **Listen without the words.** Just follow. Missed a word? Keep going – the next sentence often explains it.
2. 👂 **Listen again**, still without the words. You'll catch more.
3. 📄 **Show transcript** – listen + read. **Tap any line** you missed to hear just that part again.
4. 👂 **Hide it** and listen one last time.

listen.text: At one o'clock, Tom took Nam to lunch at a small Italian place round the corner. Tom talked fast. Very fast. And Nam understood about half of it. Rather than asking him to repeat everything, Nam smiled and nodded. It seemed to work.
So how long have you been in Manchester?
Two days. I'm still getting used to the weather.
Everyone says that. Give it a month. You won't even notice the rain.

The afternoon was harder. Nam met eight people, and by four o'clock he had forgotten six of their names. Although everyone was friendly, his head was full. He spent an hour on his new laptop, and it took him twenty minutes just to log in.
At half past five, Claire stopped by his desk.
That's normal. The first week is always the hardest. In other words, go home and rest!

parts.title: How was it?
parts.md: No quiz. Tell me how much you understood – and ask me anything in the box below. Then 📤 **Submit** and go to the next small lesson.
